description.value: North Vancouver Hotel is a recently renovated motel-style property situated at the base of the North Shore mountains, minutes from Grouse Mountain, the Capilano Suspension Bridge, and the Horseshoe Bay Ferry Terminal. The hotel offers a variety of room types including kitchenettes, pet-friendly rooms, and suites, with complimentary continental breakfast and free parking. Its location near major North Shore cycling corridors and ferry connections makes it a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists moving between Vancouver Island and the mainland.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates OSM contact details (address, phone, email all match). The amenities page lists laundry, luggage storage, vending machines, and free Wi-Fi explicitly; continental breakfast is mentioned as complimentary. No mention of bike-specific storage, bike procedures, drying areas, e-bike charging, or bike wash anywhere on the site, so those remain null.
concerns: Website notes the swimming pool and pool area are permanently closed; no impact on cyclist utility but worth noting for general accuracy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, recently renovated hotel with an active website and confirmed contact details. Practical overnight stop for touring cyclists on the North Shore.
